goalSetup.title: Set your training goal
goalSetup.question: Tell us what result you want to reach. The plan's volume, intensity and workout length are built from it. Current level and target date are optional, but with them the plan sets the starting load and timeline more precisely.

schedule.title: Your schedule
schedule.question: Choose the days you can train and how long a workout usually lasts. The plan spreads the load over the selected days only, leaves recovery time between hard sessions and puts the long run on the day that suits you.

structure.title: Plan structure
structure.question: Set how many weeks the preparation takes, how many workouts a week and what to focus on. This defines how fast the load grows and which workouts appear more often. You will see the whole plan and can adjust it before it is created.
